inputs.text: Taking a 24-hour strike to the Presidential Palace over job guarantees looks less like a last resort than an attempt to force the government’s hand. The government says it has already met the most significant demands; if the remaining issue is assurances, it should be handled through serious negotiation—not by disrupting services families rely on. Job security matters, but public workers also have a duty to protect the stability of education, not use it as leverage.
